capabilities.reason: MERGE INTO is a first-class Delta operation; performance depends on file pruning and partition layout.
limitations: Large merges without ZORDER or partitioning rewrite many files; combine with OPTIMIZE.

conditions.reason: Deletion vectors require reader protocol 3 / writer protocol 7 (DBR 14.1+, Delta 3.x, EMR with the matching runtime).

capabilities.reason: Deletion vectors mark rows deleted without rewriting files - they pin the table to protocol r3/w7; older readers cannot read the table.
limitations: Enabling DVs is one-way unless the table is rewritten; verify all readers support protocol 3.
Writers without DV support fail on tables with the feature enabled.

capabilities.reason: Column mapping decouples logical column names from file column names, enabling rename/drop without rewrites.
limitations: Mode 'name'/'id' is irreversible without a full rewrite; older readers fail.

capabilities.reason: Change Data Feed emits change records per commit; storage cost grows with enabled tables and few consumers.
limitations: CDF data expires with the log retention window - readers must consume within it.
CDF is not a CDC pipeline - order across merges is commit order, not key order.

conditions.reason: Liquid clustering requires writer protocol 7 (DBR 15.1+/Delta 3.x class runtimes).

capabilities.reason: Liquid clustering replaces static partitioning/ZORDER with incremental layout - clusters evolve without full rewrites.
limitations: Tables using clustering cannot also use partitionBy on the same keys.
OPTIMIZE with liquid clustering reclusters incrementally, not like ZORDER.

capabilities.reason: mergeSchema/autoMerge allow incoming writes to widen the table schema automatically.
limitations: Auto-merged columns arrive as NULLs for existing rows; downstream schemas must tolerate drift.

capabilities.reason: VACUUM removes data files older than the retention threshold - required for GDPR and storage cost.
limitations: The default 7-day retention bounds time travel; shorter retention risks version recovery.

capabilities.reason: OPTIMIZE compacts small files; ZORDER co-locates related rows for skipping.
limitations: OPTIMIZE is not automatic; no OPTIMIZE on merge-heavy tables = small-file debt.
